title: Study Visa Consultant Nepal | Kathmandu Digital Desk — SK Immigration
description: SK Immigration prepares study and visit files for applicants in Nepal — Germany, UK, Canada and Europe. Digital-first from Kathmandu, appointment if you want a meeting. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you have an office in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Yes. SK Immigration is digital-first and also meets in Kathmandu by appointment. WhatsApp +92 304 5999859 for the current meeting point and a written scope.

faqs.question: Can Nepali students apply for Germany or the UK through you?
faqs.answer: We prepare files against the destination country’s current rules for Nepali passports — APS/blocked account themes for many German degree paths, CAS/funds for the UK, and so on. Missions in Kathmandu or the responsible post decide the visa.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS from Nepal?
faqs.answer: It depends on the university and visa category. Some paths accept other English tests or MOI letters; Ausbildung usually needs German. We will not pretend IELTS is always optional.

faqs.question: Is this a Nepal-only consultancy?
faqs.answer: No. SK Immigration is one digital desk with offices in Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Nepal and Bangladesh. Nepali clients get the same written-fee process.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee a student visa from Nepal?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and universities decide. We prepare complete files and explain gaps honestly.

body:
SK Immigration is a digital study-visa desk for applicants in Nepal, with a Kathmandu appointment option. You do not have to fly to Pakistan. You also do not get a different, weaker file because you are in Nepal — the checklist follows the destination mission, not a local rumour.

Who this page is for

Students and parents in Kathmandu, Pokhara and across Nepal searching for a study visa consultant in Nepal who works online, puts fees in writing, and refuses “100% visa” claims.

What we prepare for Nepali applicants

  • Germany degree files (APS sequencing where required, funds/blocked-account guidance, language reality)
  • Germany Ausbildung guidance — employer/training contract still has to be real; we do not invent one
  • UK, Canada, Ireland and other study files when the academics and funds match
  • Visit files and attestation when the destination actually asks for them

Digital first in Nepal

Share scans on WhatsApp. We return a pathway note: destination fit, missing papers, government fees vs our fee. If you want someone to sit with the file in Kathmandu, book an appointment. Most families finish the whole process remotely.

Honest limits

  • We cannot create a blocked account, CAS, or I-20
  • We cannot skip Nepal’s own passport/police/attestation steps when they apply
  • Low marks and long gaps need a realistic destination — not a slogan

How to start from Nepal

  1. Send academics, passport biodata and budget range
  2. Written scope before any payment
  3. Document pack + SOP/CV support as agreed
  4. Optional Kathmandu meeting
  5. You attend the official appointment. The mission decides.
